Event and controller reviews remain selected while both flat lists hide all rows. The explicit entry link opens the existing controller review. Chinese, English and Japanese retain selection, focus, delivery status and no-inference text at 390px without horizontal overflow.

Publisher and subscriber navigation opens frozen original binding ranges. A new real run clears both event and controller selections. Plan/build/run, filtering, language changes, review navigation and repeated execution preserve every author byte.
